stories.title: Vande Mataram ends after 2 stanzas in Karnataka Assembly and Council; BJP legislators recite full version

en.title: Vande Mataram ends after 2 stanzas in Karnataka Assembly and Council; BJP legislators recite full version
en.summary: The official rendition of Vande Mataram in the Karnataka Assembly and Council concluded after two stanzas. BJP members subsequently protested by reciting the full version and shouting slogans against the government.

stories.title: Delhi Court sets aside Magistrate order refusing probe in Sonia Gandhi’s pre-citizenship electoral entry

en.title: Delhi Court sets aside Magistrate order refusing probe in Sonia Gandhi's pre-citizenship electoral entry
en.summary: A Delhi court overturned a magistrate's decision to dismiss a complaint regarding Sonia Gandhi's electoral participation before acquiring citizenship. The court found the magistrate erred by not examining whether the complaint alleged a cognizable offence.

stories.title: BJP legislators recite full Vande Mataram after official recording ends at two stanzas

en.title: BJP legislators recite full Vande Mataram after official recording ends at two stanzas
en.summary: After an official recording of Vande Mataram ended at two stanzas in the Karnataka legislature, BJP legislators recited the complete version and protested the government's decision not to play it fully.

en.title: Setback for Sonia Gandhi: Court scraps order refusing probe in electoral roll case
en.summary: A court cancelled a previous order that had refused to investigate a matter involving Sonia Gandhi and an electoral roll case.
